name: Question 17
problem:
Consider the following system of linear equations:

$$
{\begin{aligned}-x-2y+4z=-3 \\ 2x+4y-8z=6 \\ -3x-6y+12z=-9\end{aligned}
$$

Use the standard Gauss-Jordan method to reduce the augmented matrix $M$ of the system to reduced row echelon form.
worked_solution:
The augmented matrix for this system is

$$
M=[\begin{aligned}-1 & -2 & 4 & -3 \\ 2 & 4 & -8 & 6 \\ -3 & -6 & 12 & -9\end{aligned}].
$$

Transforming $M$ to reduced row echelon form, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}M & ∼[\begin{aligned}-1 & -2 & 4 & -3 \\ 2 & 4 & -8 & 6 \\ -3 & -6 & 12 & -9\end{aligned}] & {R}_{1} & :=-{R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 2 & -4 & 3 \\ 2 & 4 & -8 & 6 \\ -3 & -6 & 12 & -9\end{aligned}] & {R}_{2} & :={R}_{2}-2{R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 2 & -4 & 3 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & 0 \\ -3 & -6 & 12 & -9\end{aligned}] & {R}_{3} & :={R}_{3}+3{R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 2 & -4 & 3 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & 0\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$
